alert_rules.message: GPS jamming: prefer passive/multidomain (SAR/ELINT) before heavy surface approach.
alert_rules.full_text: When GPS jamming or PNT degradation is assessed, cue passive and multidomain ISR (SAR, ELINT) before committing heavy surface units that advertise intent. FLASH priority may override heavy-surface blocks when C2 directs immediate action.

alert_rules.message: Pipeline corridor: coordinate national C2; avoid public-domain disclosure of exact segment.
alert_rules.full_text: AIS blackout adjacent to a critical underwater infrastructure segment requires bilateral/national C2 coordination. Do not publish exact pipeline segment identifiers in UNCLASSIFIED products; tasking follows national pipeline sovereignty procedures.

alert_rules.message: Russian fleet proximity: passive ISR first; surface escalation requires explicit ROE gate.
alert_rules.full_text: Adversary fleet proximity in the Baltic theatre defaults to passive ISR and MC 362/2–compatible first response. Heavy surface escalation requires explicit ROE and discovery threshold review unless contact remains undetected below policy limits.

coa_legal_notes.A: Multidomain cueing; share metadata under existing bilateral arrangements.
coa_legal_notes.B: Heavy surface + EO — confirm territorial sea / EEZ tasking.
coa_legal_notes.C: K130 + ALB — shallow-water only; depth and turbidity gates apply.
